verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Typesense or the Typesense Cloud dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. The Cloud MCP server lets an external agent such as Claude manage clusters, which is a separate integration story. Natural Language Search and RAG are search features for end users, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
